pb-seo-strategy.title: Learn from a measured experiment
pb-seo-strategy.boundary: Choose checked article evidence and a frozen panel for the same order. Learning waits for a verified publication and complete baseline and later captures. Two flat windows stop the experiment.
pb-seo-strategy.state.candidate: Candidate saved. Complete the publication and observation evidence before learning from it.
pb-seo-strategy.state.held: Held until the complete, unchanged evidence supports a result.
pb-seo-strategy.state.remembered: Remembered from the measured experiment. This is evidence, not a ranking promise.
pb-seo-strategy.failed: Could not bind this experiment. Recheck the article source, same-order panel and verified publication.
